extracted.intended_audience: prospective authors and illustrators; teachers and librarians; educators and booksellers seeking publisher services or materials
extracted.subtask_description: Publisher FAQ describing how to request review copies and promotional materials, contact authors, inquire about rights/permissions, obtain alternate formats, and the policy for manuscript submissions (unsolicited manuscripts not accepted).

rubrics_metrics.name: Imprint location
rubrics_metrics.description: The imprint may be found on the spine or copyright page of the book.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For more information about imprints and divisions please visit our Divisions and Imprints page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rights & Permissions inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: Please visit our Rights & Permissions section for information on inquiring about subsidiary or translation rights or to request permission to reprint copyrighted material.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Rights & Permissions page for subsidiary/translation rights questions and reprint permissions; consult Divisions and Imprints for imprint details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review copy request requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for review copies from teachers or librarians must be sent via email to [email protected] and include complete contact information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requests should include full contact details (name, institution, mailing address, phone/email as appropriate) to be considered; intended specifically for teachers and librarians.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promotional materials request requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: To request promotional materials for classroom and library use such as posters, bookmarks, and reading group guides, email [email protected] and include your complete contact information and quantity of materials desired.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify quantity desired and provide full contact information when requesting promotional materials for classroom/library use.

rubrics_metrics.name: eBook purchasing for libraries/academic/K-12
rubrics_metrics.description: Simon & Schuster offers eBooks to the library, academic, and K-12 markets through a number of wholesalers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact your preferred wholesaler to inquire about purchasing Simon & Schuster eBooks for institutional markets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternate format texts for print disabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: For alternate formats for students with print disabilities, please visit Bookshare.org.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Bookshare.org as the resource for obtaining alternate-format texts for students with print disabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contacting an author via publisher
rubrics_metrics.description: You may write to an author in care of Simon & Schuster using the publisher's publicity address (format shown).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address letters as: (Author's Name) c/o (Imprint or Division*) Publicity Department Simon & Schuster, LLC 1230 Avenue of the Americas New York, NY 10020. Use the imprint/division when known.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscript submissions policy
rubrics_metrics.description: As a general policy, Simon & Schuster does not review or return unsolicited manuscripts or artwork.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prospective authors and illustrators are advised to submit materials through a professional literary agent. The publisher cannot recommend specific agents but refers to the Literary Market Place directory (www.literarymarketplace.com). Alternatively, authors wishing to self-publish are invited to explore Archway Publishing (www.archwaypublishing.com).
